sampling_model.design: Two equal-sized arms are randomized before monitoring; for every \(N\ge N_0\), the treatment arm receives the interior capacity \(M_N=\lceil Na+\gamma\sqrt N\rceil\), and the two aggregate arm processes evolve independently in stationarity.
sampling_model.units: Each arm contains \(N\) finite-source participants; dependence among treatment participants is induced by shared service capacity.
sampling_model.treatment: Control participants recover naturally at rate \(\tau\); treated participants additionally recover through service at aggregate rate \(\nu\min\{K_{1,N},M_N\}\).
sampling_model.overlap: Randomization identifies the implemented arm contrast; the model-based time-series law conditions on the realized equal arm sizes and capacity.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The primitive rates \((\lambda,\tau,\nu)\) are estimated from marked transition counts divided by their at-risk occupation exposures on the same two paths.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: For fixed finite arm sizes and staffing, the occupation contrast obeys a large-duration central limit theorem; separately, the many-system treatment effect has a deterministic fluid limit.
A piecewise Ornstein--Uhlenbeck diffusion approximates the stationary normalized system size in Wasserstein distance at order \(N^{-1/2}\) in its many-server model.
Prelimit Poisson equations can shift Stein-factor analysis from diffusion derivatives to finite differences for static steady-state approximation.
Mixing triangular arrays admit quantitative functional central limit bounds under stated moment and mixing conditions.
For a fixed countable-state CTMC, the Poisson martingale and likelihood-ratio score have a joint Brownian limit, and centered likelihood-ratio estimator variance is bounded in duration.
Estimating nuisance parameters by score equations can reduce the oracle sandwich variance by a score-projection term in regular estimating-equation models.
Square-root staffing is asymptotically optimal for an open call center under staffing and delay costs.
Queue-informed estimators and confidence intervals improve inference for stochastic-congestion experiments in an open single-server system.
Double machine learning yields efficient inference under conditional shared-state interference.

body.tldr: Capacity-constrained service trials sit where the published fixed-system central limit theorem and fluid approximation do not meet. The core proves compact-uniform stationary path, generator, Poisson-energy, and joint marked-score limits for the actual scaled finite chains; derives the fixed-implemented-staffing projection that changes fitted-center residual variance to \(V-A^{\mathsf T}\Gamma A\); and turns the piecewise-diffusion variance into a rationally certified capacity decision. Exact-center inference permits arbitrary joint divergence of \(N\) and \(T_N\), whereas fitted diffusion centering uses the derived weakest sufficient relation \(T_N=o(N)\). The load-bearing open question is the order \(N^{-1/2}\) expected residual \(\mathbb E|(G_{1,N}-\mathcal L_{\gamma_N})h_{1,N}|\) through the moving kink.

project_justification.gap: The operational-dosage literature provides a finite-system long-duration law and a separate fluid threshold, while its planning calculations assume oracle queueing quantities. Static steady-state diffusion approximation and fixed-chain score sensitivity do not close the joint critical inference problem.
project_justification.niche: A one-dimensional finite-source birth--death structure permits exact prelimit flux identities, yet the critical staffing kink makes fitted centering and variance design nontrivial. This creates a tractable but genuinely new bridge between experimental operational dosage, Markov additive-functional inference, and certified capacity choice.
project_justification.fill: The paper establishes stationary path and generator convergence for the named scaled lattices, proves the exact-centered joint Gaussian law without an artificial horizon exponent, isolates the kink residual needed for fitted intervals under \(T_N=o(N)\), and returns a rational interval certificate with explicit semantics and finite worst-case complexity.

body.related_work: Boutilier, Jonasson, Li, and Yoeli define the identical operational occupation effect and critical capacity scale, but their Theorem 1 fixes the finite system and their Theorem 2 is a separate fluid result; Theorem 2 here strictly joins population and duration divergence for their model. Braverman and Dai supply piecewise-diffusion Poisson and generator-comparison tools for static steady-state approximation, while Braverman's prelimit formulation informs the lattice residual route; neither is claimed as a theorem-level extension. Hafouta informs uniform triangular-array reasoning, although the exact Poisson martingale here removes any need for an arbitrary upper horizon exponent in exact-center inference. Wang and Plechac derive the fixed-CTMC score--Poisson mechanism adapted to marked rate estimation. Lok establishes generic score-projection variance subtraction, so novelty lies in the fixed-implemented-capacity derivative and critical finite-source realization. Borst, Mandelbaum, and Reiman inform square-root staffing recovery, while Corliss and Rall and Jansson and Knueppel provide the validated quadrature and branch-and-bound ingredients formalized here as a rational oracle. Li, Johari, Kuang, and Wager already establish queue-informed inference for an open stochastic-congestion system; this claim is confined to the closed finite-source critical window. Hays and Raghavan address general shared-state interference but do not derive this primitive CTMC limit or capacity certificate.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The numerical witness \((\lambda,\tau,\nu,\gamma)=(1,1,1,0)\) gives floating-point values \(V=0.4804862942\) and \(W=0.4076427604\), but these remain diagnostics rather than certified theorem outputs. The rational interval oracle is a mathematical specification, not an implemented library. Marked recovery causes, stationary initialization, independent arms, compactly positive rates, and a bounded staffing window are substantive restrictions. The fitted-center theorem must be dropped if the uniform kink-residual question fails, although exact-center empirical inference and the exact Poisson-martingale law may remain viable.
body.honest_scope: The exact birth--death flux representation, limiting density, score-covariance algebra, and explicit interior threshold provide strong traction but are not treated as proved. The principal open content is the compact-uniform residual bound on the scaled treatment lattice and its order \(N^{-1}\) effect-centering consequence. Exact-center joint inference requires only \(N,T_N\to\infty\); the additional operational regime \(T_N=o(N)\) is imposed only for diffusion-fitted centering because the available center remainder becomes \(O(\sqrt{T_N/N})\) after normalization. The proposal does not claim randomization inference after assignment, efficiency under unmarked histories, robustness to common shocks, arbitrary initialization, heterogeneous risk classes, or a clinical cure effect.
